about.title: About the SejmInsight project
about.body: SejmInsight is a modern analytics and community platform that creates space for public debate. Our goal is transparency and providing tools that allow every citizen to evaluate the actions of their representatives.
about.notice: The project is in an early stage of development. Features such as login and aggregation of data from the Sejm API are being rolled out gradually.
